suppress.notes: CVE-2012-2055 is a mass-assignment flaw in GitHub Enterprise before 20120304 (the public-key update form). Microsoft.SourceLink.GitHub 10.0.404 is a build-time MSBuild package, referenced with PrivateAssets="all", that records GitHub source URLs in PDBs; it contains no GitHub Enterprise server code and is not shipped as a runtime dependency. The match comes from the "GitHub" product name, so this is a reviewed false positive. Code scanning alert #47.

CVE-2026-24051 is an untrusted search path issue in the OpenTelemetry Go SDK's sdk/resource/host_id.go implementation on macOS. The OpenTelemetry.Exporter.OpenTelemetryProtocol 1.21.0 NuGet package is the managed .NET OTLP exporter and does not contain or execute that Go implementation. Dependency-Check matched the shared OpenTelemetry product name, so this is a reviewed ecosystem false positive. Code scanning alerts #228 and #229.

CVE-2026-54285 is an inbound W3C baggage parsing issue in the @opentelemetry/core JavaScript package before 2.8.0. The OpenTelemetry.Exporter.OpenTelemetryProtocol 1.21.0 NuGet package is the managed .NET OTLP exporter and does not contain that JavaScript package or its W3CBaggagePropagator implementation. Dependency-Check matched the shared OpenTelemetry product name, so this is a reviewed ecosystem false positive. Code scanning alerts #75 and #76.
